pages.text: There is no familiar food in this world, and you can't last long without it. Nothing can grow here due to the lack of soil and plants, so you can't stay in one place for too long. I will now write down the main sources of food.
In some places on the surface, you can sometimes find strange packages. If you tear them open in your inventory, you can get several quite edible pieces of dried bread, although they taste awful.

In the furniture section, you can sometimes find places where perfectly appetizing food sits on round white stands. Its biggest drawback is that it's not renewable, and you can only find more by moving forward.

In this world, there is an alternative to chests—they open from the side, not the top. You can often find something to drink or eat inside, but there's also a lot of rotten stuff. Once, I even found a strange square metal thing with a handle there—I was able to break quite a few heads with it.

pages.title: Strange food
pages.text: When I was starving, I remembered hearing that you can eat paper too. I had to scrape it off the walls and moisten it with water. It tastes disgusting, but you don't always have a choice. Using the same principle, I later made soup from sawdust, using a board I broke by hand instead of paper.
